title.zh: 美国2026财年预算赤字逼近2万亿美元，特朗普削减开支成效受挫
title.en: 美国2026财年预算赤字逼近2万亿美元，特朗普削减开支成效受挫

current_state.zh: US FY2026 federal budget deficit rose to $1.99 trillion — the highest since the pandemic — as military, Social Security and debt-interest costs climbed, corporate tax receipts fell, and a Supreme Court tariff ruling forced over $100 billion in refunds, pushing the deficit above 6% of GDP.
